source: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker Application Guide

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB) or NCLC Level 5 or higher for jobs in NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, and 3 (Skilled Worker, Critical Construction Worker and Occupations in Demand categories)

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: An approved language test showing at least CLB/NCLC 4 is mandatory for jobs in NOC TEER 4 and 5, issued within two years of the NSNP submission

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: 12 complete calendar months of paid work within the last 5 years and a minimum of 1,560 hours, related to the job being offered (volunteer work and unpaid internships do not count)

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: If your job offer falls under the NOC TEER category 4 or 5, you have 6 months’ paid work experience with the Nova Scotia employer who is offering you the job
requirements.section: A) Skilled Workers — NOC TEER 4 or 5

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: The employer must have operated in Nova Scotia for at least 2 years

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You must be paid a salary that meets provincial employment standards and the provincial wage range for your specific occupation

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Before you submit an EOI to the Skilled Worker stream, find out if you need a licence or certificate to do the job you have been offered
requirements.section: You may need a licence or certificate for the job you have been offered

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream — Skilled Worker category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You have a high school diploma

requirements.stream: Nova Scotia Nominee Program — Skilled Worker stream — Critical Construction Worker category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: You have a high school diploma OR proof you have completed a construction specific industry training program
requirements.section: B) Critical Construction Workers — Education Requirements - CCW
